title: Build context-management system
businessObjective: Reduce repeated context transfer while preserving accurate, auditable task decisions and verification boundaries.
technicalObjective: Add bounded context builders, artifact summarization, size checks, handoff templates, and context packs for every active task.
assumptions: Node and npm remain the repository-standard runtime.
Canonical documents are linked, not duplicated into context packs.
Context files are durable governance records and may be tracked.
acceptanceCriteria: Every active task has the six required context files.
Builders enforce relevant-file and byte-budget boundaries and never paste canonical architecture documents.
Handoffs include changed files, tests, facts, interpretation, unresolved decisions, and remaining budget.
Artifact summaries preserve exact failure lines while labeling interpretation and Qwen preprocessing.
solEscalationTriggers: A context builder would expose protected data or duplicate canonical authority.
A summary cannot preserve exact errors or separate facts from interpretation.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only this task's context system files; preserve generated durable context and evidence until a reviewed archival action.
